therapeutic_hypothesis.target_population: Parkinson's disease patients with motor 'OFF' episodes

results.effect_size: 365/496 participants (73.6%) experienced adverse events during the LTS phase
results.target_engagement_evidence: Mean change from pre-dose in MDS-UPDRS Part III motor score of up to -23.2 points at 30 minutes post-dose

MDS-UPDRS Part III score change at Week 36: -11.7 (15 min), -22.3 (30 min), -21.3 (60 min), -13.3 (90 min)
MDS-UPDRS Part III score change at Week 48: -13.3 (15 min), -23.2 (30 min), -22.3 (60 min), -16.6 (90 min)
safety_signals: 365 of 496 participants experienced adverse events during the LTS phase
Serious cardiac events reported including acute myocardial infarction (3/496), atrial fibrillation (2/496), cardiac failure congestive (3/496), cardiac arrest (1/496)
